summary: Original local .ics import review for Calendar. A pure, bounded parser (src/ui/calendar-import.ts) builds a preview with all-day, UTC, floating and zoned times (runtime IANA zones, file VTIMEZONE yearly rules or fixed offsets, a Windows-name table), RFC 5545 DST handling (gap times move forward, repeated times use the first occurrence, nominal DURATION days), and recurrence expanded only inside an explicit window with per-series, per-preview and step caps. Unsupported rules are skipped and counted. Reserved or prototype names, oversized, deeply nested, unbalanced and over-limit records are rejected per item. The typed component (CalendarImport.tsx) shows found/selected/conflict/already-stored/skipped counts, per-event zone and DST notes, conflicts with stored events and with other selected events, per-event checkboxes and bulk selection, and calls the host's onImport only after a ConfirmDialog. It reads no files, uses no network or storage, and changes no schedule or system setting.

checks.result: 16 tests, 16 pass, 0 fail (worst-case 2000 recurring zoned events: parse about 0.7 s, review about 10 ms on this machine)

testCoverage: IANA offsets on both sides of DST, vendor-prefixed TZID
DST gap (moves forward) and repeated hour (first occurrence)
Weekly recurrence keeps local time across DST; nominal P1D across spring-forward
VTIMEZONE yearly rules, fixed-offset VTIMEZONE, Windows zone name, unknown zone skipped
Open-ended rule fast-forwarded into the window; 400-occurrence cap flagged; COUNT series wholly in the past reported
MONTHLY -1FR, BYMONTHDAY=31 skipping short months, YEARLY Feb 29, UNTIL inclusive, EXDATE, RECURRENCE-ID move and cancel
HOURLY, BYSETPOS, COUNT+UNTIL, two RRULEs, RDATE PERIOD, RANGE=THISANDFUTURE skipped and counted; plain RDATE expanded

__proto__ property/parameter/component names, too many fields, overlong folded line, bad dates, year range, reversed and mixed ranges, cancelled, VTODO, stray END, deep nesting, >1 MB, not-calendar; Object.prototype unchanged; bidi/control characters stripped; javascript: URL dropped
Conflicts with stored and selected events, half-open back-to-back, all-day and TRANSP:TRANSPARENT excluded, floating times in the display zone, duplicates excluded from default selection
Import request has only selected events, no RRULE/TZID, and round-trips through electron/services/calendar.ts parseIcs with zero skips and identical events
Server-rendered component: counts, conflict text, skip labels, DST note, checkbox state, button label, error notice, paste box toggle, onImport never called by rendering
Confirmation and outcome copy; duration parser accept/reject

interfaceProposal.module: src/ui/calendar-import.ts exports parseIcsForImport(text, { now, lookbackDays?, horizonDays? }) -> ImportPreview; defaultSelection(preview, existing); reviewSelection(preview, selectedKeys, existing, timeZone?) -> SelectionReview; buildImportRequest(preview, selectedKeys, sourceName, stamp) -> { ok: true, request: CalendarImportRequest } | { ok: false, reason }; formatWhen(event, timeZone?); IMPORT_LIMITS; IMPORT_SKIP_LABELS; CANDIDATE_NOTE_LABELS.
interfaceProposal.component: src/components/CalendarImport.tsx exports CalendarImport({ existing: CalendarEvent[], source?: { name, text } | null, onImport(request): Promise<{ added, dropped, total }>, onClose?, now?, timeZone?, allowPaste? }), plus outcomeMessage and confirmationLines.
interfaceProposal.request: CalendarImportRequest = { sourceName, events: CalendarEvent[], ics }. ics contains only UTC, all-day or floating times and no recurrence, so the existing calendarImportText / CalendarClient.importIcs route can store it unchanged after the main process parses it again.
interfaceProposal.mountInCalendar: Captain or the Calendar owner (src/components/Calendar.tsx is not owned here) can replace or sit beside PreviewPanel: after the file input's File.text() is read (size-checked as today), set a memoized source state { name: file.name, text } and render <CalendarImport existing={events ?? []} source={source} onImport={(r) => api.importIcs(r.ics)} onClose={() => setSource(null)} />, then reload the list on success. The source object must be memoized (useState), because a new object resets the preview. No new IPC channel or contract field is needed.
interfaceProposal.navigation: No new nav entry required; it belongs inside the Calendar page. If a central host is preferred, mount the same element in a Calendar sub-panel or dialog with the same props.

limitations: Not mounted in Calendar.tsx or any route: that file and navigation are outside this ownership. Until the captain mounts it, users still get the existing store-parser preview (no zones or recurrence).

Recurrence subset only: DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY/YEARLY with INTERVAL, COUNT or UNTIL, BYDAY (ordinals only for MONTHLY and YEARLY+BYMONTH), BYMONTHDAY, BYMONTH, WKST; RDATE (DATE/DATE-TIME) and EXDATE; RECURRENCE-ID without RANGE. Anything else is skipped and counted, not approximated.

Recurring events are expanded only between now-31 days and now+365 days by default (configurable up to 366/1098), at most 400 occurrences per series and 2000 events per preview; imported occurrences become individual events, so the store does not keep the rule and future occurrences beyond the window need a later import.

VTIMEZONE support covers fixed observances and yearly nth-weekday rules; RDATE-based or other observance rules fall back to the Windows table or are skipped. The runtime IANA database wins over file VTIMEZONE data when the TZID is a known region name.

Conflict checks use only timed busy events; all-day and TRANSP:TRANSPARENT events are listed but not checked. Floating and all-day times are interpreted in the display zone for conflicts; the existing store treats floating times as UTC for its own range queries.
The existing store key is UID+start, so importing a changed occurrence at a new time adds a new event rather than replacing the old one.
Rendering and pure flows are tested with react-dom/server; click-through interaction (checkbox toggle, dialog confirm) has no DOM test because no DOM test library is installed and none was added.
